WITH order_avg AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
time_in_force_avg AS (
  SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_of_order_avg_fills
  FROM order_avg
  GROUP BY timespan
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.timespan,
    oa.avg_fill,
    oa.avg_fill - tif.avg_of_order_avg_fills AS excess_over_time_in_force_avg,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY oa.timespan
      ORDER BY oa.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_avg AS oa
  JOIN time_in_force_avg AS tif
    ON oa.timespan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tif.timespan
  WHERE oa.avg_fill > tif.avg_of_order_avg_fills
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_over_time_in_force_avg, fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;
